title: Small Compiler Subset Scene/Block Expansion
purpose: Expand the sealed small compiler subset fixture lane across larger scene and block shapes while Ruby remains the production parser, resolver, compiler path, and referee.

allowed: adding compiler/small_compiler_subset_scene_block_expansion.rb as a non-production expansion harness
validating larger ordered scene/block programs that combine KINDS, DEFINE, START, WHEN, IF, OTHERWISE, CONTROLS, HOVER, and CONTEXT
locking expanded subset BSharp IR digests against the Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver referee
locking plain-English errors for broken expanded block shapes through the existing error contract
preserving existing runtime, BSharp Bytecode, Save, ASK, input devices, web, browser, and engine bridge behavior
forbidden_until_later_approval: replacing compiler/parser.rb as the production parser authority
changing runtime meaning, BSharp Bytecode, Save format, ASK output, input devices, graphics, engine bridge, browser work, web export, or Ruby retirement

acceptance_rules: The scene/block expansion tool must pass in the Trial-by-Fire validation inventory.
Every valid expanded fixture must match Ruby Parser plus SemanticResolver BSharp IR output.
Every valid expanded fixture must match its locked normalized BSharp IR SHA256 digest.
Every invalid expanded fixture must map to stable plain-English error records.
The expansion harness must not become the production compiler path in this build.
No Profile 8, new syntax, runtime, bytecode, web export, browser, engine bridge, or Ruby retirement work is allowed.
